title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Sixth edition, Volume 6, CHI-Crystallization - EB.11
text: After these operations, the cloth being dried, is re- turned to the cloth-worker, who shears it a second time, and returns it to the carerés, who respect the operation up before, till the map he will ranged on the surface of the cloth, from one end of the piece to the other.
